channel.title: Kali :: SE How-To Build Lab
channel.description: Assumptions TCGUI is built and running Kali Lab Topology Location The installation steps below, creates a Kali VM in the following location in the lab NIC VNET IP Address eth0 OFFNET 10.100.66.88 eth1 FTNTMGMT 10.100.55.88 Download and Import ISO Kali Installer Image - ISO Import the Kali ISO file Create Kali VM If you get the error No route to host with any of the following steps, use the Troubleshoot Ansible steps ​ RDP to OOB from Terminal in OOB cd /home/fortinet/automation/ansible/ubuntu ./create_kali.sh ../vars/all-hosts.yml <PVE server name> kali <ISO file name (no extension..just file name)> ./start_stop_remove_vm.sh ../vars/all-hosts.yml <PVE server name> kali started Kali Installer ​ via Kali VM console in Proxmox Kali Linux installer menu Choose Graphical install Select Language, Location, Keyboard Primary NIC used for installation eth0 Not using DHCP Continue Do not configure the network at this time Hostname kali Username kali Password kali (not recommended for production, this is for non-internet facing lab) Choose Time zone Partition disks Guided - use entire disk sda All files in one partition Finish partitioning and write changes to disk Write the changes to disks? Yes Software selection Desktop environment: Xfce Collection of tools: top10 and default Install the GRUB boot loader: Yes Device for boot loader location: /dev/sda Installation complete Continue VM reboots NIC Configuration ​ via Kali VM console in Proxmox Login Username/Password : kali/kali In upper right corner of desktop, right-click on Network Settings and Edit Connections Double Click on Wired connection 1 Configure Wired connection 1 Ethernet / eth0 IPv4 Settings/Manual/Address/Netmask/Gateway/DNS/Search domains Click Save Click on + Choose a Connection Type Ethernet and Click on Create Configure Wired connection 2 Ethernet / eth1 IPv4 Settings/Manual/Address/Netmask (Leave Gateway Blank) Click Save In upper right corner of desktop, right-click on Network Settings and see the following Configure RDP ​ RDP to OOB Update package list: sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y Install XRDP: sudo apt install -y xrdp Enable XRDP service: sudo systemctl enable xrdp Start the service sudo systemctl start xrdp Check the service status to verify it is running: sudo systemctl status xrdp Logout and RDP to Kali VM (10.100.55.88) IMPORTANT:You must be logged out of the xfce desktop to successfully RDP to Kali Complete
